india_trends.title: Uflex shares surge 16% after Q1 profit zooms 630% YoY
india_trends.summary: Uflex shares rallied after the company reported a 630% YoY jump in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 423.3 crore. Revenue grew 38% to Rs 5,366 crore, while EBITDA surged 92% to Rs 919.8 crore. The EBITDA margin expanded to 17%, marking the company’s highest level in 21 quarters.
